papers.title: ACG Clinical Guideline: Colonic Diverticulitis
papers.authors: Peery A, Strate L, Stollman N, Mankaney G, Chang J, Grover S
papers.abstract: Colonic diverticulitis is a common and costly disease, with a lifetime risk of 3%-5%, that drives substantial healthcare use. This guideline provides practical, evidence-based recommendations for the management of diverticulitis in the outpatient gastroenterology setting. Consultations should address diagnosis, typical clinical course, risk factors, the role of antibiotics, and prevention. Computed tomography imaging is essential to confirm the diagnosis of diverticulitis, particularly at the first presentation and in severe cases. After recovery, colonoscopy is recommended for patients with complicated diverticulitis and suggested for those with uncomplicated disease who have alarm symptoms or are not up to date with colorectal cancer screening to rule out an underlying malignancy. Patients treated nonoperatively remain at substantial risk for recurrence, which increases with each episode, whereas complicated diverticulitis most often occurs at the initial presentation. For patients with a history of diverticulitis, lifestyle measures-including a healthy diet (without avoiding nuts, seeds, corn, or popcorn), regular physical activity, achieving or maintaining a healthy weight, avoidance of smoking and heavy alcohol use, and limiting nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs use when possible-may help reduce the recurrence risk. Because randomized trials show little or no benefit, we suggest against routine antibiotics for low-risk patients with acute uncomplicated diverticulitis. Antibiotic use is appropriate for patients with high-risk features, immunocompromise, frailty, or inability to ensure safe outpatient management. Patients with recurrent, uncomplicated diverticulitis that significantly affects quality of life should be referred for surgical consultation to discuss the risks and benefits of elective colon resection.
papers.abstract_zh: 結腸憩室炎是常見且耗費醫療資源的疾病，終生罹病風險為3%-5%，造成大量醫療使用。本指引針對門診胃腸科憩室炎的處置提供實證基礎的實用建議。諮詢應涵蓋診斷、典型臨床病程、危險因子、抗生素角色及預防。電腦斷層影像對於確診憩室炎至關重要，尤其是初次發作及重症病例。復原後，對於複雜性憩室炎建議接受大腸鏡檢查；對於非複雜性憩室炎但有警示症狀或未按期完成大腸直腸癌篩檢者，亦建議接受大腸鏡以排除潛在惡性腫瘤。接受非手術治療的患者仍有相當高的復發風險，且此風險隨每次發作增加；而複雜性憩室炎最常發生於初次發作時。對於有憩室炎病史者，生活方式措施——包括健康飲食（不需避免堅果、種子、玉米或爆米花）、規律運動、達到或維持健康體重、避免吸菸與過量飲酒，以及盡可能限制非類固醇消炎藥使用——可能有助於降低復發風險。由於隨機試驗顯示幾乎無益處，我們建議對於低風險的急性非複雜性憩室炎患者不常規使用抗生素。抗生素使用適用於具高風險特徵、免疫低下、體弱，或無法確保安全門診處置的患者。對於復發性非複雜性憩室炎且顯著影響生活品質者，應轉介外科會診，討論選擇性大腸切除的風險與益處。

papers.title: Digital self-management programme for pain, fatigue and faecal incontinence in inflammatory bowel disease: cost-effectiveness analysis of the IBD-BOOST randomised controlled trial
papers.authors: Roukas C, Miller L, Büttner F, Hamborg T, Gordeev V, Wileman V
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: People living with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) frequently experience abdominal pain, fatigue and faecal incontinence that persist despite optimal medical treatment. This study aimed to assess the cost-effectiveness of IBD-BOOST, a digital, interactive, facilitator-supported self-management intervention targeting these symptoms.
METHODS: A cost-effectiveness analysis was conducted alongside the IBD-BOOST trial, which randomised people with IBD experiencing fatigue, pain and/or faecal incontinence to the IBD-BOOST intervention (N=391) or care as usual (N=389) over 12 months. While the IBD-BOOST intervention did not significantly improve the primary trial outcome measures (UK Inflammatory Bowel Disease Questionnaire and global rating of symptom relief), trends towards benefit were observed across study outcomes. Therefore, this analysis focuses on secondary health economic outcome measures. The cost of the intervention, including its development, facilitation and delivery, was assessed. Participants reported their health service use, out-of-pocket expenses and time off work over the previous 3 months and their health-related quality of life at baseline, 6-month and 12-month follow-up. Participants' costs (2023 UK£) and quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) over the 12 months were compared between study arms using mixed effects models.
RESULTS: The IBD-BOOST intervention resulted in additional per participant 0.016 QALYs (95% CI 0.002 to 0.030) over the 12 months in the study and cost savings of -£304.66 (-803.51 to 194.18) for healthcare and -£39.48 (-388.09 to 309.12) for out-of-pocket costs and time off work over months 4-6 and 10-12. This resulted in cost savings of -£28 633 (95% CI -51 555 to 18 764) and -£33 568 (-64 421 to 26 198) per QALY gained with IBD-BOOST from health services and societal perspectives, respectively, and high probability of cost-effectiveness.
CONCLUSION: The IBD-BOOST intervention is highly likely to be cost-effective for the self-management of pain, fatigue and faecal incontinence in people living with IBD.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: ISRCTN71618461.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：IBD病人常合併腹痛、疲勞與大便失禁，即使接受最佳藥物治療仍持續存在。本研究旨在評估IBD-BOOST（一項數位、互動式、由facilitator支持的自我管理介入措施）針對上述症狀的成本效益。方法：本成本效益分析伴隨IBD-BOOST試驗進行，該試驗將有疲勞、疼痛及/或大便失禁的IBD病人隨機分派至IBD-BOOST介入組（N=391）或常規照護組（N=389），追蹤12個月。雖然IBD-BOOST介入並未顯著改善試驗主要結果指標（英國IBD問卷及整體症狀緩解評分），但各項研究結果均呈現獲益趨勢。因此本分析聚焦於次要健康經濟結果指標。評估項目包括介入措施成本（開發、facilitation與執行），並於基準期、6個月與12個月追蹤時，收集參與者過去3個月的醫療服務使用、自付費用、請假時數，以及健康相關生活品質。以混合效應模型比較兩組於12個月間的成本（2023年英鎊）與品質調整生命年（QALYs）。結果：IBD-BOOST介入使每位參與者於12個月內額外獲得0.016 QALYs（95% CI 0.002至0.030），並於第4-6個月及第10-12個月期間節省醫療照護成本-£304.66（-803.51至194.18）及自付費用與請假時間成本-£39.48（-388.09至309.12）。以此換算，從醫療服務角度與社會角度觀之，每獲得一個QALY，IBD-BOOST分別節省成本-£28,633（95% CI -51,555至18,764）與-£33,568（-64,421至26,198），且具有高成本效益機率。結論：IBD-BOOST介入對於IBD病人疼痛、疲勞與大便失禁的自我管理，極可能具有成本效益。

papers.title: Testing behavioral economics principles in mailed FIT outreach: a randomized trial
papers.authors: Adedipe O, Bartmann N, Greenblatt L, Bradicich H, Sullivan Jones M, Cardona D
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Mailed stool-based fecal immunochemical testing (FIT) can improve colorectal cancer (CRC) screening rates. We aim to determine whether enhancing communications with evidence-based behavioral economics principles in mailed FIT kits further improves screening rates.
METHODS: This study focused predominantly on Medicare patients at average-risk for colon cancer who were not up-to-date on CRC screening. Patients were randomly assigned to one of two interventions: original communication (a series of standard communications, including a pre-mailing letter, FIT kit and letter, and reminders via text or robo-call); or enhanced communication (the same sequence, but incorporating behavioral economics principles to encourage FIT completion). We compared the rate of FIT tests completed at 90 days and factors associated with completion.
RESULTS: 4,070 patients were included. Within 90 days, 27% of all patients successfully completed the FIT test: 28.1% of patients receiving the enhanced communication had FIT test completed compared to 25.5% of patients receiving the original communication. The adjusted risk difference for obtaining patients' FIT tests within 90 days was 2.2% (95% CI = -0.4%, 4.9%) for the enhanced communication outreach compared to the original communication (p = 0.094). Younger participants and patients experiencing greater area-level deprivation were less likely to complete the screening.
CONCLUSION: The FIT test screening rate in the enhanced communication group was not statistically different from the original communication group. Using evidence-based behavioral economics principles in mailed FIT communications did not markedly improve the rate of CRC screening, but mailed FIT remains a key, cost-effective tool for reaching unscreened individuals.

papers.title_zh: 在郵寄FIT外展中測試行為經濟學原則：一項隨機試驗
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：郵寄式糞便免疫化學檢測（FIT）可提升大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢率。本研究旨在確定於郵寄FIT套件中加入以證據為基礎的行為經濟學原則強化溝通，是否能進一步提升篩檢率。方法：本研究主要針對未達最新CRC篩檢標準之中低風險Medicare病人。病人隨機分配至兩種介入之一：原始溝通（一系列標準通訊，包括寄件前信函、FIT套件與信函、以及簡訊或機器人語音提醒）；或強化溝通（相同流程，但加入行為經濟學原則以鼓勵完成FIT）。我們比較90天內完成FIT檢測之比率，以及與完成率相關之因子。結果：共納入4,070名病人。90天內，所有病人中27%成功完成FIT檢測：接受強化溝通之病人有28.1%完成FIT檢測，相較於接受原始溝通之病人為25.5%。強化溝通相較於原始溝通，在90天內取得病人FIT檢測結果之調整後風險差為2.2%（95%信賴區間 = -0.4%至4.9%，p=0.094）。較年輕之參與者以及居住於地區層級較貧困地區之病人，較不易完成篩檢。結論：強化溝通組之FIT篩檢完成率與原始溝通組相比，並無統計上顯著差異。在郵寄FIT溝通中使用以證據為基礎的行為經濟學原則，並未明顯提升CRC篩檢率，但郵寄FIT仍是接觸未篩檢個體的重要且具成本效益之工具。

papers.title: Magnetic Resonance Imaging After Total Neoadjuvant Therapy in Rectal Cancer: Treatment-Oriented Response Assessment and Reporting for Watch-and-Wait Management
papers.authors: Kim H, Jang J, Gollub M
papers.abstract: Total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) is increasingly recognized as a standard treatment option for locally advanced rectal cancer. By increasing rates of clinical complete response (cCR) and thereby expanding opportunities for nonoperative management, TNT has elevated the role of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in assessment of rectal cancer treatment response. Restaging MRI is shifting away from reliance on tumor regression grading systems, which have demonstrated limited correlation with pathologic findings, toward more clinically relevant assessments integrated with flexible endoscopy. The identification of cCR now incorporates diffusion-weighted imaging to improve sensitivity for detecting residual tumors and specificity for confirming cCR, thereby enabling safer selection of patients eligible for organ preservation. Growing acceptance that small foci of residual tumor, consistent with a near-complete response, can be safely managed with short-interval surveillance has further broadened eligibility for nonoperative management, reinforcing the central role of MRI in contemporary rectal cancer care.

papers.title_zh: 全直腸新輔助治療（TNT）後之磁振造影：以治療導向反應評估作為觀察等待（Watch-and-Wait）處置之報告依據
papers.abstract_zh: 全直腸新輔助治療（TNT）已日益被認可為局部惡化直腸癌的標準治療選項。由於TNT提高了臨床完全緩解（cCR）之比率，進而擴大非手術治療（nonoperative management）的機會，MRI在直腸癌治療反應評估中的角色因此提升。再分期MRI正逐漸從依賴腫瘤退縮分級（TRG）系統（此系統與病理結果相關性有限）轉向更具臨床意義、並結合軟式內視鏡的評估方式。目前cCR之判定已納入擴散加權影像（DWI），以提升偵測殘餘腫瘤之敏感度、及確認cCR之特異度，藉此使器官保留適格病人之篩選更為安全。此外，越來越多共識認為與接近完全緩解（near-complete response）一致的微小殘餘腫瘤病灶，可以短間隔追蹤方式安全處理，這進一步擴大了非手術治療的適用範圍，強化了MRI在當代直腸癌照護中的核心角色。
papers.score_reason: 為權威期刊之敘述性回顧，整理現行TNT後MRI再分期與W&W篩選共識，臨床實用性高，但無原始數據、非系統性回顧，證據等級有限。

papers.title: Microbiota metabolite butyrate alleviates intestinal inflammation associated with enhanced autophagy-related signaling in DSS-induced colitis
papers.authors: Mao Q, Lin B, Zhang W, Zhang Y, Lei Y, Zhang Z
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The incidence of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) has been demonstrated to be increased over recent decades. Butyrate derived from the gut microbiota is known to be beneficial in alleviating inflammation, yet the underlying mechanisms remain undefined.
METHODS: Human and mice fecal samples were analyzed using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry and 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Male wild-type C57BL/6J mice aged 6-8 weeks old were administered dextran sodium sulfate (DSS) to induce experimental colitis models. Mice were treated with sodium butyrate (SB) through oral gavage. 3-methyladenine (3MA) was administered intraperitoneally to suppress autophagy in mice.
RESULTS: Our results showed that the butyric acid level in the feces of IBD patients was significantly lower than those in healthy controls (HCs) (134.5 vs. 605.9, p = 0.002), concomitant with a deficiency in butyrate-producing probiotics, such as Faecalibacterium. We found that oral SB changed the composition of the intestinal microbes (higher abundance of Barnesiella), restored intestinal barrier function determined by enhanced tight junction protein expression (OCCLUDIN) in Western blotting and diminished the susceptibility of mice to DSS-induced colitis. Additionally, autophagy levels in the intestine were significantly increased in SB group with enhanced protein levels of ATG16L1 and LC3-II, and reduced level of p62/SQSTM1 protein. While the SB group showed changes consistent with enhanced autophagy-related signaling, 3MA-treated mice conversely displayed significantly attenuated autophagy activity. Meanwhile, the butyrate-mediated protection against colonic injury was considerably diminished in the 3MA-treated mice.
CONCLUSION: Our findings provide multi-line evidence that SB coordinates gut microbiota and is associated with enhanced autophagy-related signaling to alleviate inflammation in DSS-induced colitis, integrating human fecal metabolomic and microbiome analyses with in vivo pharmacological and transcriptomic data.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）的發生率近幾十年來已被證實持續上升。腸道菌叢產生的丁酸鹽已知有助於減輕發炎，但其潛在機轉仍未明確。方法：以氣相層析質譜法與16S rRNA基因定序分析人類與小鼠糞便樣本。使用6-8週齡雄性野生型C57BL/6J小鼠，以葡聚糖硫酸鈉（DSS）誘導實驗性結腸炎模式。以口服灌食方式給予小鼠丁酸鈉（SB）。以腹腔注射3-methyladenine（3MA）抑制小鼠自噬作用。結果：結果顯示IBD病患糞便中丁酸濃度顯著低於健康對照組（134.5 vs. 605.9，p = 0.002），並伴隨產丁酸益生菌（如Faecalibacterium）的缺乏。口服SB改變了腸道微生物組成（Barnesiella豐度增加），透過西方墨點法測得緊密連接蛋白（OCCLUDIN）表現增強，恢復腸道屏障功能，並降低小鼠對DSS誘導結腸炎的易感性。此外，SB組小鼠腸道自噬程度顯著提升，ATG16L1與LC3-II蛋白量增加，p62/SQSTM1蛋白量降低。SB組顯示與自噬訊號增強一致的變化，而3MA處理組則顯著減弱自噬活性。同時，丁酸鹽介導的結腸損傷保護作用在3MA處理小鼠中明顯減弱。結論：本研究提供多重證據，顯示SB透過調節腸道菌叢並增強自噬相關訊號傳導，減輕DSS誘導結腸炎之發炎反應，整合了人類糞便代謝體學與微生物體學分析，與活體藥理學及轉錄體學數據。

papers.title: Deciphering the Functional Mechanisms of eIF3f in Tumors and Exploring Targeted Therapies
papers.authors: Hao Y, Shao J, Lian N, Bian M
papers.abstract: Eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 subunit F (eIF3f) is a critical component of the eIF3 complex and plays a pivotal role in diverse biological processes, including cell proliferation, apoptosis, adhesion, and transcriptional regulation. Recent studies have revealed that eIF3f is aberrantly expressed in multiple malignancies and exhibits a striking context-dependent functional profile. In solid tumors such as hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), colorectal cancer (CRC), and prostate cancer (PCa), elevated eIF3f expression correlates with poor patient prognosis, indicating an oncogenic role. Conversely, in pancreatic cancer (PC) and melanoma (MM), reduced or absent eIF3f expression promotes tumor progression, suggesting a tumor-suppressive function. This functional plasticity indicates that eIF3f is not a simple oncogenic driver but rather a molecular hub that integrates diverse cellular signals. This review systematically delineates the structural characteristics and biological functions of eIF3f, summarizing its expression patterns and underlying molecular mechanisms across various malignancies. Building on this, we propose an integrated mechanistic framework that attributes the functional plasticity of eIF3f to differential upstream signaling networks, heterogeneity in post-translational modification profiles, and the remodeling status of the tumor microenvironment (TME). Furthermore, we critically evaluate the strength of evidence supporting eIF3f as a diagnostic and prognostic biomarker, identify methodological bottlenecks and translational challenges in current targeting strategies, and outline priority research directions, including elucidating the structural biological basis of its functional plasticity and developing context-specific intervention strategies. By integrating mechanistic insights with clinical relevance, this review aims to establish a conceptually coherent and mechanistically testable theoretical framework for eIF3f research, guiding the design of precision stratified therapeutic approaches and facilitating its substantive translation from basic research to clinical application.
papers.title_zh: 解析eIF3f在腫瘤中的功能機制並探索其靶向治療策略
papers.abstract_zh: 真核生物translation initiation factor 3 subunit F（eIF3f）是eIF3複合體的關鍵組成部分，在細胞增殖、凋亡、黏附及轉錄調控等多種生物學過程中扮演關鍵角色。近期研究顯示，eIF3f在多種惡性腫瘤中表現異常，並呈現顯著的情境依賴性功能特徵。在肝細胞癌（HCC）、大腸直腸癌（CRC）及前列腺癌（PCa）等固態腫瘤中，eIF3f表現升高與較差的病人預後相關，顯示其具致癌作用。相反地，在胰臟癌（PC）及黑色素瘤（MM）中，eIF3f表現降低或缺失則促進腫瘤進展，暗示其具腫瘤抑制功能。這種功能可塑性表明eIF3f並非單純的致癌驅動因子，而是整合多種細胞訊號的分子樞紐。本綜述系統性闡述eIF3f的結構特性與生物學功能，總結其在各類惡性腫瘤中的表現模式與潛在分子機制。在此基礎上，我們提出一個整合性機制框架，將eIF3f的功能可塑性歸因於不同的上游訊號網路、轉譯後修飾譜的異質性，以及腫瘤微環境（TME）的重塑狀態。此外，我們批判性評估eIF3f作為診斷及預後生物標記的證據強度，指出目前靶向策略在方法學上的瓶頸與轉譯挑戰，並提出優先研究方向，包括闡明其功能可塑性的結構生物學基礎，以及開發情境特異性的干預策略。透過整合機制洞見與臨床相關性，本綜述旨在建立一個概念一致且機制上可驗證的理論框架，以指引精準分層治療策略的設計，並促進其從基礎研究到臨床應用的實質轉譯。

papers.title: Complications and survival after Ivor Lewis esophagectomy
papers.authors: Abu Hejleh A, Lemties J, Kreutzer I, Wirsik N, Krauss D, Torabi S
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Esophagectomy (OE) remains a complex procedure with a considerable risk of severe postoperative complications. There is conflicting evidence if major postoperative complications impair long-term oncological survival. This retrospective study was designed to retest the hypothesis that complications after OE impact on long-term survival in a large and highly standardized cohort of esophageal cancer patients.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: 733 patients who underwent Ivor Lewis esophagectomy (IL-OE) for cancer from 2016 to 2021 at our tertiary center were analysed from a prospectively maintained database. Postoperative complications were correlated to overall survival.
RESULTS: Neither occurrence of major complications ≥ Clavien-Dindo (CD) IIIB (Median OS not reached in both groups, p = 0.45, HR 1.12) nor AL (Median OS not reached for no AL vs. 50 months for AL, p = 0.49, HR 0.96) nor pulmonary complications (Median OS not reached in both groups, p = 0.61, HR 0.76) had an impact on overall survival. However, the necessity for postoperative readmission to ICU (reaICU) had a significant impact on overall survival (Median OS not reached for no reaICU vs. 40 months for reaICU, p = 0.037, HR 1.54). Mean follow up was 27 months.
CONCLUSION: Among all variables, only ICU readmission significantly affected overall survival. Postoperative complications and in particular anastomotic leakage after IL-OE, per se, may have a less significant impact on overall survival than previously anticipated. This might be due to a highly sufficient management of complications that progressively avoids requirement of severe septic complications and intensive care treatment.

papers.title_zh: Ivor Lewis食道切除術後之併發症與存活
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：食道切除術（OE）仍是複雜的手術，術後嚴重併發症風險相當高。目前對於術後重大併發症是否影響長期腫瘤學存活，證據仍存在矛盾。本回溯性研究旨在於一大型高度標準化的食道癌病人世代中，重新檢驗『OE術後併發症影響長期存活』此一假說。

材料與方法：分析2016年至2021年間於本三級醫學中心接受Ivor Lewis食道切除術（IL-OE）治療癌症之733名病人，資料來自前瞻性維護之資料庫。將術後併發症與整體存活（overall survival）進行相關性分析。

結果：無論是Clavien-Dindo（CD）分級≥IIIB之重大併發症（兩組中位OS皆未達到，p=0.45，HR 1.12）、吻合口廔（AL）（無AL組中位OS未達到 vs. AL組50個月，p=0.49，HR 0.96），或肺部併發症（兩組中位OS皆未達到，p=0.61，HR 0.76），皆對整體存活無顯著影響。然而，術後需重返加護病房（reaICU）者，對整體存活有顯著影響（無reaICU組中位OS未達到 vs. reaICU組40個月，p=0.037，HR 1.54）。平均追蹤時間為27個月。

結論：在所有變項中，僅ICU重返顯著影響整體存活。IL-OE術後併發症，尤其是吻合口廔本身，對整體存活的影響可能比先前預期的來得小。這可能是因為對併發症有高度有效的處置，能逐步避免嚴重敗血性併發症與加護病房治療的需求。

papers.title: Inflammasomes in digestive diseases: mechanisms and therapeutic potential
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Zhao X, Tian Z, Li M, Luo N, Chu X
papers.abstract: Inflammasomes are key multiprotein complexes in the innate immune system, playing crucial role in maintaining immune homeostasis and responding to pathogen invasion. Recent researches have increasingly unveiled the intricate and pivotal role of inflammasomes in the onset and progression of digestive diseases. This article provides a comprehensive review of the biological basis of inflammasomes, conducts an in-depth analysis of their relationship with the pathophysiological characteristics of digestive diseases, and elucidates the dual-edged nature of inflammasomes in modulating disease progression, tissue damage, and repair. We specifically highlight their activation processes, signaling pathways, and roles in the pathogenesis and pathological processes of common digestive disorders such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), gastritis, liver disease, and pancreatitis. Additionally, the article provides a detailed discussion of therapeutic strategies targeting inflammasomes and their potential clinical applications. In summary, targeting inflammasomes provides a new perspective and potential therapeutic approach for the treatment of digestive diseases.

papers.title: The Mediating Roles of Self-Disclosure and Social Support in the Relationship Between Self-Perceived Burden and Benefit Finding Among Postoperative Colorectal Cancer Patients
papers.authors: Zhou Y, Wang Y, Guo J, Wen J, Guo H
papers.abstract:
AIM: To explore the mediating roles of social support and self-disclosure in the association between self-perceived burden and benefit finding among postoperative colorectal cancer patients and to provide evidence that may inform nursing practice.
DESIGN: A cross-sectional descriptive study.
METHODS: From November 2023 to June 2024, 165 patients who had undergone colorectal cancer surgery were recruited from a Class III Grade A hospital in China using convenience sampling. Data were collected using the Benefit Finding Scale, Self-Perceived Burden Scale, Social Support Rating Scale, and The Distress Disclosure Index Scale. Correlation analysis and mediation effect tests were conducted.
RESULTS: Benefit finding was negatively correlated with self-perceived burden (r = -0.687, p < 0.01) and positively correlated with self-disclosure and social support (r = 0.712, 0.696, p < 0.01). Self-perceived burden is associated with benefit finding through three mediating pathways: the mediating effect of social support was -0.193 (28.2% of the total effect); the mediating effect of self-disclosure was -0.153 (22.3%); and the chain mediating effect of social support and self-disclosure was -0.049 (7.1%).
PATIENT OR PUBLIC CONTRIBUTION: No Patient or Public Contribution.
IMPLICATIONS FOR NURSING PRACTICE: This study suggests that assessment of self-perceived burden may be considered as part of routine nursing assessment for postoperative colorectal cancer patients. Interventions aimed at enhancing social support and encouraging self-disclosure may be worthy of further investigation, as these factors were associated with higher levels of benefit finding in this study.

papers.title: A pilot randomized trial on the usability and acceptability of an app (MyIBDDiet) to improve the self-management of anti-inflammatory diet for individuals with inflammatory bowel disease: A protocol paper
papers.authors: Kaur R, van Diepen K, Raiesdana S, Chappell K, Ajibulu L, Gozdzik M
papers.abstract:
UNLABELLED: The role of diet in the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is increasingly recognized with recent guidelines providing specific dietary recommendations. Although mobile health apps targeting diet and lifestyle habits in IBD are emerging, few are designed for self-management or have been formally evaluated for effectiveness. We have co-designed a diet guidance and tracking app (MyIBDDiet) with and for patients with IBD with the aim of improving overall diet profile. We will be conducting a 60-day single-centre pilot randomized trial of 40 IBD patients randomized in 1:1 ratio to MyIBDDiet app or usual care. Participants in the usual care group will crossover to the MyIBDDiet app group after 30 days. Primary outcome is usability assessed using a mixed method quantitative [Theoretical Framework of Acceptability (TFA), mHealth App Usability Questionnaire (MAUQ)], and qualitative approach (semi-structured interviews). Secondary outcomes include clinical efficacy evaluated by change in diet quality [Mini-EAT questionnaire, Automated Self-administered 24-Hour Dietary Assessment Tool (ASA-24), Healthy Eating Index (HEI), Mediterranean Diet Serving Score (MDSS)], changes in biomarkers of processed food intake (spot urine sodium and chloride), changes in IBD disease activity [Patient Reported Outcome (PRO2 and PRO3), C-reactive protein, fecal calprotectin], changes in quality of life [EuroQol-5 Dimension (EQ-5D), Short Inflammatory Bowel Disease Questionnaire (SIBDQ)] and safety. Exploratory outcomes include changes in fecal microbiome and serum and fecal metabolome. Additional quantitative data will be collected from the digital analytics of MyIBDDiet app. The pilot data generated will inform the design of an adequately powered randomized trial and future mobile app development and evaluation by providing a framework for evaluation of clinical effectiveness.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT06683105. Registered on 8 November 2024.

papers.title: Spatio-temporal patterns and prediction of colorectal cancer mortality in Chinese cancer registration areas: A nationwide study based on multiple models
papers.authors: Zhao Y, He X, Shao J, Zhu L, Chu Z, Man Y
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To describe the spatiotemporal distribution characteristics of colorectal cancer (CRC) mortality in Chinese cancer registration areas and to predict its future trends, thereby providing an epidemiological basis for CRC prevention and control in China.
METHOD: This study used cancer registry data from 2005 to 2018, collected from the China Cancer Registry Annual Report (2008-2021), to comprehensively describe CRC mortality patterns. Joinpoint regression models were employed to calculate the annual percentage change (APC) and average annual percentage change (AAPC) to analyze temporal trends. The age-period-cohort model was used to disentangle the effects of age, period, and cohort. A Bayesian age-period-cohort (BAPC) model was constructed to predict future trends for 2019-2035. Global and local spatial autocorrelation methods were applied to describe the spatial distribution of CRC mortality and to identify high-risk areas.
RESULTS: From 2005 to 2018, in Chinese cancer registration areas, the mortality of CRC was 14.45/100,000, and the age-standardized mortality rate (ASMR) was 11.13/100,000 [95% confidence interval (CI): 11.03, 11.27]. From 2005 to 2007, the mortality rate of CRC showed an upward trend, with an APC of 3.67% (95% CI: -0.77%, 8.33%); from 2007 to 2013, there was a significant downward trend with an APC of -2.45% (95%CI: -3.14%, -1.47%); from 2013 to 2018, there was an upward trend with an APC of 0.13% (95% CI: -0.88%, 1.17%). From 2007 to 2013, the CRC mortality rates of different genders showed a significant downward trend. In urban areas from 2009 to 2018, the CRC mortality rate showed a significant downward trend with an APC of -1.21% (95% CI: -1.71%, -0.71%), but in rural areas, it showed a significant upward trend with an AAPC of 0.59% (95% CI: 0.24%, 1.56%). The age effects indicated that the risk of CRC death increased with age. From 2019 to 2035, the ASMR of CRC in Chinese cancer registration areas will generally show a slow upward trend. Spatial autocorrelation analysis showed that the mortality rate of CRC in Chinese cancer registration areas exhibited spatial clustering characteristics, with hotspots concentrated in the eastern coastal and northeastern provinces.
CONCLUSIONS: The mortality rate of CRC in Chinese cancer registration areas showed a trend of first increasing, then decreasing, and then increasing from 2005 to 2018. It was predicted that it will continue to rise from 2019 and still face a series of challenges such as urban-rural, gender, and regional inequality. In the future, more targeted prevention and control strategies should be adopted, combined with dietary and lifestyle interventions, to further reduce the burden of CRC.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：描述中國癌症登記地區大腸直腸癌（CRC）死亡率之時空分布特徵，並預測其未來趨勢，為中國CRC防治提供流行病學依據。方法：本研究使用2005至2018年之癌症登記資料（取自2008-2021年中國癌症登記年報）全面描述CRC死亡型態。採用Joinpoint迴歸模型計算年度百分比變化（APC）及平均年度百分比變化（AAPC）以分析時間趨勢。使用年齡-時期-世代模型分離年齡、時期、世代之效應。建構貝氏年齡-時期-世代（BAPC）模型以預測2019-2035年之未來趨勢。應用全域與局域空間自相關方法描述CRC死亡率之空間分布並辨識高風險地區。結果：2005至2018年間，中國癌症登記地區CRC死亡率為14.45/10萬，年齡標準化死亡率（ASMR）為11.13/10萬〔95%信賴區間(CI)：11.03, 11.27〕。2005至2007年，CRC死亡率呈上升趨勢，APC為3.67%（95% CI: -0.77%, 8.33%）；2007至2013年呈顯著下降趨勢，APC為-2.45%（95% CI: -3.14%, -1.47%）；2013至2018年呈上升趨勢，APC為0.13%（95% CI: -0.88%, 1.17%）。2007至2013年，不同性別的CRC死亡率均呈顯著下降趨勢。2009至2018年都市地區CRC死亡率呈顯著下降趨勢，APC為-1.21%（95% CI: -1.71%, -0.71%），但農村地區呈顯著上升趨勢，AAPC為0.59%（95% CI: 0.24%, 1.56%）。年齡效應顯示CRC死亡風險隨年齡增加而上升。2019至2035年，中國癌症登記地區CRC之ASMR整體將呈緩慢上升趨勢。空間自相關分析顯示中國癌症登記地區CRC死亡率呈現空間群聚特徵，熱點集中於東部沿海及東北省份。結論：2005至2018年中國癌症登記地區CRC死亡率呈現先上升、後下降、再上升之趨勢。預測自2019年起將持續上升，且仍面臨都市-農村、性別、區域不平等等一系列挑戰。未來應採取更具針對性之防治策略，結合飲食與生活型態介入，以進一步降低CRC負擔。

papers.title: Uptake and Use of Biologic Therapies in Paediatric Immune-Mediated Inflammatory Diseases: An Australian Population-Based Study
papers.authors: Ho J, Hillen J, Nassar N, Zoega H, Beukelman T, Pratt N
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: To quantify the real-world use and describe characteristics of paediatric patients initiating biologic medicines for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases (IMIDs).
METHODS: Dispensing claims for Australians aged less than 18 years were used to examine uptake and use trends of nine biologic medicines used for the treatment of IMIDs. A 15% random sample of the population was used for dispensings between 2013 and 2017, and a 30% sample for dispensings between 2017 and 2020. Incidence and prevalence rates of use per 1 000 000 population per year were calculated. Patient demographics at the time of first dispensing were determined and the number of unique medicines dispensed per person across the study period was calculated.
RESULTS: Incidence of use of biologics increased from 108 per million in 2014 to 192 per million in 2020, while prevalence increased from 352 per million to 877 per million over the same period. 1131 children were dispensed at least one biologic medicine; infliximab, adalimumab or etanercept accounted for 80% of dispensings. Mean age at first dispensing was 14 years (standard deviation: 3 years) and 51% were male. Of children initiated on biologics, 55% were first dispensed treatment for inflammatory bowel diseases and 29% for inflammatory arthropathies. While most children were dispensed only one unique biologic medicine, 15% were dispensed two, and 3% three or more over the study period.
CONCLUSIONS: These results suggest that children remain on treatment for extended periods of time and nearly one in five children were dispensed multiple biologic medicines. Post-market studies should be prioritised to monitor safety among these groups.
In this study, we examined how often biologic medicines were used by children in Australia to treat immune‐mediated inflammatory diseases and described the characteristics of those starting treatment. Using national medicine dispensing data, we found that the use of these medicines increased between 2014 and 2020, suggesting that many children stayed on treatment for long periods. The most commonly treated condition was inflammatory bowel disease. Older children were more likely to start biologic treatment than younger children, likely due to clinicians following aged‐based prescribing guidelines. A small number of children may have been using biologic medicines off‐label. While most children were dispensed only one biologic medicine, some were dispensed two or more during the study period. Although some of these medicines have been available for over a decade, there is still limited knowledge about their safety in children. Future research should focus on children using multiple biologic medicines or taking them over long periods to better understand how safe and effective these treatments really are.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的：量化真實世界中兒童免疫介導發炎性疾病（IMIDs）起始使用生物製劑之情形並描述其病人特徵。方法：利用18歲以下澳洲人之調劑理賠資料，檢視九種用於治療IMIDs之生物製劑的使用趨勢。2013至2017年間調劑資料採用15%隨機樣本，2017至2020年間採用30%樣本。計算每百萬人口每年之發生率與盛行率。並確認首次調劑時之病人人口學特徵，以及研究期間每位病人使用之獨特藥物種類數。結果：生物製劑使用發生率由2014年每百萬人108例增加至2020年每百萬人192例，盛行率則由每百萬人352例增加至877例。共1131名兒童曾被調劑至少一種生物製劑；infliximab、adalimumab或etanercept佔調劑數之80%。首次調劑時平均年齡為14歲（標準差：3歲），51%為男性。開始使用生物製劑之兒童中，55%首次為治療發炎性腸道疾病，29%為治療發炎性關節病變。多數兒童僅使用一種獨特生物製劑，但15%使用兩種，3%使用三種以上。結論：這些結果顯示兒童治療時間延長，且近五分之一兒童使用多種生物製劑。應優先進行上市後研究以監測此族群之安全性。（研究者摘要：本研究檢視澳洲兒童使用生物製劑治療免疫介導發炎性疾病之頻率，並描述起始治療者之特徵。利用全國性調劑資料發現，2014至2020年間此類藥物使用增加，顯示許多兒童長期維持治療。最常見治療疾病為發炎性腸道疾病。年齡較大兒童較常開始生物製劑治療，可能因臨床醫師依循年齡處方準則。部分兒童可能為仿單外使用。雖多數兒童僅使用一種生物製劑，部分使用兩種以上。儘管部分藥物已上市逾十年，兒童安全性資料仍有限。未來研究應聚焦於使用多種生物製劑或長期使用之兒童，以更了解其安全性與有效性。）

papers.title: Patient-centred approach to improve colorectal cancer screening (CRC) in resource-limited communities
papers.authors: Arman O, Reynolds J, Gudleski G, Bakhai S
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: The aim of this quality improvement initiative was to increase colorectal cancer (CRC) screening rates from 17.75% and 28.45% to 40% in patients aged 45-49 years and 50-75 years, respectively, at a resource-limited primary care clinic within 1 year. We identified a major gap in CRC screening in both age groups (45-49 and 50-75 years).
METHODS: We implemented multifaceted, patient-centred interventions in a community clinic serving a diverse population. The intervention incorporated the use of stool-based testing (faecal immunochemical test and multi-targeted stool DNA test), colonoscopy referrals, patient navigation, multilingual education, electronic health record alerts and a real-time tracking dashboard. The primary outcome measure was CRC screening completion rates. Colonoscopy and stool test completion rates were the process measures.
RESULTS: In 45-49 years, we observed a sustainable, steady increase in CRC screening rates from 17.75% (n=400) to 41.25% during the study period and 59.50% 6 months poststudy, with a median rate of 52.38% in a run chart and a mean of 37.00% in the statistical process control (SPC) chart. In 50-75 years, we observed a sustainable increase in CRC screening rate from 28.45% (n=2879) to 46.16% during the study period and to 61.06% 6 months poststudy, with a median rate of 55.47% in a run chart and mean of 43.00% in a SPC chart. In 45-49 years, colonoscopy completion rates increased from the baseline rate of 25.93% (n=108) to 37.04% during the study period and to 43.52% 6 months poststudy. In 50-75 years, colonoscopy completion rates increased from the baseline rate of 74.01% (n=654) to 92.05% during the study period and to 97.55% 6 months poststudy.
CONCLUSIONS: We exceeded our goals to increase CRC screening in both age groups. Patient-centred care and system-integrated interventions may substantially increase CRC screening among underserved individuals.

papers.abstract_zh: 前言：本品質改善計畫之目標，是在一年內將資源有限之基層照護診所中，45-49歲與50-75歲患者的大腸直腸癌(CRC)篩檢率，分別由17.75%與28.45%提升至40%。我們發現此兩個年齡層在CRC篩檢上均存在重大缺口。方法：我們在一間服務多元族群的社區診所中，實施多面向、以患者為中心的介入措施，包括糞便篩檢（糞便免疫化學檢測與多標靶糞便DNA檢測）、大腸鏡轉介、患者導航、多語言衛教、電子病歷警示，以及即時追蹤儀表板。主要結果指標為CRC篩檢完成率；大腸鏡與糞便篩檢完成率則為過程指標。結果：在45-49歲組，CRC篩檢率由基線17.75%（n=400）於研究期間持續上升至41.25%，研究結束後6個月達59.50%；run chart中位數為52.38%，統計流程控制(SPC)圖平均值為37.00%。在50-75歲組，CRC篩檢率由基線28.45%（n=2879）於研究期間上升至46.16%，研究結束後6個月達61.06%；run chart中位數為55.47%，SPC圖平均值為43.00%。45-49歲組之大腸鏡完成率由基線25.93%（n=108）於研究期間上升至37.04%，6個月後達43.52%。50-75歲組之大腸鏡完成率由基線74.01%（n=654）於研究期間上升至92.05%，6個月後達97.55%。結論：我們在兩個年齡層均超越了提升CRC篩檢率的目標。以患者為中心的照護及系統整合式介入措施，可能大幅提升未獲充分照護族群之CRC篩檢率。

papers.title: Operative Management of Anal Fistula in Lagos: Outcomes and Complications
papers.authors: Balogun O, Lawal A, Osinowo A, Makanjuola A, Oluseye O, Adesanya A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Fistula-in-ano (FIA) describes an anal condition in which there is a connecting tract between the perianal skin and the lining of the anal canal. Surgery is the mainstay of treatment. Disease recurrence and anal incontinence are major concerns in surgery for FIA. The conventional fistulotomy and fistulectomy have demonstrated superiority over the endoscopic and other sphincter-sparing treatments for FIA.
AIMS: The study aimed at reporting our experiences of surgery for fistula-in-ano. There is a scarcity of local studies on FIA in Nigeria, hence the need to report our experience with surgery for FIA.
METHODOLOGY: This is a retrospective review of available records of FIA cases in patients aged 16 years or more managed between February 2016 and February 2025. Information on demographical characteristics, clinical/radiological features and the type and number of surgical treatments for complete healing were retrieved from the records for analysis. Excluded from this study were patients with incomplete records and patients with secondary fistulae. Data analysis was performed using SPSS.
RESULTS: We analysed records of 30 cases of FIA. There were 24 males (80%) and 6 females (20%) giving a ratio of 4:1. The mean age of all patients was 40.8 ± 10.8 years (range: 24-60 years). The modal age group was between 30 and 39 years. Twenty-seven cases (90%) were primary FIA; all patients presented with recurrent anal discharge of pus. Twenty-three patients (76.6%) presented with perianal pain. The number of external openings recorded was single in 22 patients (76.6%). Three patients presented with horseshoe-type FIA. Low-type fistula accounted for 90% of cases. Surgical treatments offered were anal fistulectomy in 11 patients (36.7%), partial fistulectomy and insertion of cutting seton in 11 (36.7%) patients, anal fistulotomy in seven patients (23.3%). Procedure-related complications occurred in six patients (20%). Occasional faecal incontinence was documented by two patients (6.7%). Recurrence after healing of the fistula tract was seen in two patients (6.7%).
CONCLUSION: FIA occurs mostly in males; the majority are of low posterior type. Surgical deroofing or excision of the tract with surgical or seton fistulotomy has a good success rate. It is recommended as the first line of treatment in low-resource settings.
papers.title_zh: 拉哥斯地區肛門廔管之手術治療：成果與併發症
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：肛門廔管（FIA）是一種肛門疾病，指會陰皮膚與肛管內壁之間存在連通管道。手術是主要治療方式。疾病復發與肛門失禁是FIA手術的主要顧慮。傳統廔管切開術與廔管切除術已證實優於內視鏡及其他保留括約肌的治療方式。

目的：本研究旨在報告我們治療肛門廔管手術的經驗。奈及利亞當地關於FIA的研究稀少，因此有必要報告我們的手術經驗。

方法：這是一項回溯性病歷回顧研究，納入2016年2月至2025年2月間年齡16歲以上、可取得完整病歷的FIA病例。從病歷中蒐集人口學特徵、臨床/影像學特徵，以及達到完全癒合所需之手術治療種類與次數，進行分析。排除病歷不完整及續發性廔管的病人。使用SPSS進行資料分析。

結果：共分析30例FIA病例，男性24例（80%）、女性6例（20%），比例為4:1。所有病人平均年齡為40.8±10.8歲（範圍24-60歲），最常見年齡層為30-39歲。27例（90%）為原發性FIA；所有病人皆以反覆性肛門排膿為表現。23例（76.6%）出現會陰疼痛。外口數目單一者為22例（76.6%）。3例為馬蹄型廔管。低位型廔管佔90%。手術治療方式包括：肛門廔管切除術11例（36.7%）、部分廔管切除併掛線術11例（36.7%）、肛門廔管切開術7例（23.3%）。6例（20%）發生手術相關併發症。2例（6.7%）記載偶發性糞便失禁。廔管癒合後復發2例（6.7%）。

結論：FIA多發生於男性，多數為低位後方型。手術掀蓋或切除廔管管道，配合手術性或掛線廔管切開術，成功率良好。建議作為資源有限環境下的第一線治療。

papers.title: Bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes exert therapeutic effects on inflammatory bowel disease through miR-148a-3p/Ets-1-dependent inhibition of pyroptosis
papers.authors: Zhang F, Song J, Zhang Y, Hu H, Zhou P, Xu C
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a non-specific chronic inflammatory condition of the gastrointestinal tract, characterized by damage to intestinal epithelial cells (IECs) and inflammation. Mesenchymal stem cell-derived exosomes show therapeutic potential in IBD, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigates the therapeutic potential of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell (BMSC)-derived exosomes and their molecular mechanism in IBD. We isolated and characterized exosomes from mouse BMSCs, confirming their typical size, morphology, and marker expression. In a dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced mouse IBD model, administration of BMSC-derived exosomes alleviated disease severity, colon shortening, and histopathological damage. In LPS + ATP-stimulated IECs, BMSC-exos upregulated miR-148a-3p expression, enhanced cell viability, and suppressed pyroptosis-related proteins, including NOD-like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3), ASC, cleaved caspase-1, and the N-terminus of GSDMD (GSDMD-N), and inflammatory cytokines interleukin 1β (IL-1β), IL-18, tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), and IL-6. Bioinformatics and dual-luciferase reporter assays identified E26 avian leukemia oncogene 1, 5' domain (Ets-1) as a direct target of miR-148a-3p. Ets-1 knockdown reversed the effects of miR-148a-3p inhibition on IEC pyroptosis and inflammation. In conclusion, BMSC-derived exosomes deliver miR-148a-3p to IECs, where it targets Ets-1 to suppress cellular pyroptosis and inflammatory responses, offering a novel therapeutic strategy for IBD.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種胃腸道非特異性慢性發炎疾病，特徵為腸上皮細胞（IECs）損傷與發炎。間質幹細胞來源外泌體在IBD展現治療潛力，但其機轉仍不明確。本研究探討骨髓間質幹細胞（BMSC）來源外泌體之治療潛力及其分子機轉。我們分離並鑑定了小鼠BMSC外泌體，確認其典型大小、型態與標記表現。在葡聚糖硫酸鈉（DSS）誘導之小鼠IBD模型中，給予BMSC來源外泌體可減緩疾病嚴重度、結腸縮短及組織病理損傷。在LPS+ATP刺激之IECs中，BMSC外泌體上調miR-148a-3p表現、增強細胞存活率，並抑制焦亡相關蛋白，包括NOD樣受體蛋白3（NLRP3）、ASC、剪切型caspase-1及GSDMD之N端片段（GSDMD-N），以及發炎細胞激素IL-1β、IL-18、TNF-α與IL-6。生物資訊學分析與雙螢光素酶報告基因實驗確認E26禽白血病致癌基因1（Ets-1）為miR-148a-3p之直接標靶。Ets-1敲低可逆轉miR-148a-3p抑制對IEC焦亡與發炎之作用。結論：BMSC來源外泌體將miR-148a-3p遞送至IECs，靶向Ets-1以抑制細胞焦亡與發炎反應，為IBD提供一項新穎治療策略。

papers.title: Metabolic set theory: a generalized model of microbial interactions
papers.authors: Jyoti J, Zoller H, Zu Castell W, Hütt M
papers.abstract: Understanding the composition of microbial communities in their environment remains a challenge due to the complex interplay of factors like inter-species interactions and nutrient availability. In this context, it has become an established approach to use overlap in functional subsets of metabolic networks as indices of synergy and competition among microorganisms. Here, we show that this idea can actually be reduced to a much simpler principle. Leveraging the agent-based community modeling software BacArena and natural co-occurrence patterns in the human gut microbiome for a systematic comparison, we find that simple set-theoretical indices explain interactions to a similarly high degree as more sophisticated, established approaches based on network topology. Furthermore, we observe that the performance of most indices decreases substantially for patients diagnosed with obesity or inflammatory bowel disease, suggesting a systemic decline in the microbiome.
papers.title_zh: 代謝集合論：微生物交互作用的廣義模型
papers.abstract_zh: 了解微生物群落在其環境中的組成仍是一項挑戰，原因在於物種間交互作用與營養可利用性等因素的複雜交互影響。在此背景下，使用代謝網路功能子集的重疊作為微生物間協同與競爭的指標，已成為一種成熟的研究方法。本文顯示，這個概念其實可以簡化為一個更簡單的原則。我們利用基於代理人的社群建模軟體 BacArena，並以人類腸道微生物體中的自然共存模式進行系統性比較，發現簡單的集合論指標解釋交互作用的程度，與基於網路拓樸的更複雜、成熟方法相當。此外，我們觀察到，對於被診斷為肥胖症或發炎性腸道疾病的病患，大多數指標的表現顯著下降，顯示微生物體出現系統性衰退。

papers.title: Urban residents' health literacy of four major cancers: a cross-sectional national survey
papers.authors: Lyu Y, Guo W, Wang Z, Paterson C, Lin F
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Cancer poses a significant global healthcare challenge, and individual health literacy directly impacts screening and the adoption of self-care behaviors.
OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to compare health literacy scores for four cancers (colorectal, esophageal, lung, and kidney) among Chinese urban residents and to identify associated factors.
METHODS: A descriptive cross-sectional study recruited 1,226 urban adults via professional networks across China. Participants provided demographic data and completed a validated health literacy questionnaire. Multiple linear regression was used to analyze associations with health literacy scores.
RESULTS: Health literacy scores ranked as follows: colorectal (7.50 ± 3.35), esophageal (6.27 ± 3.15), lung (5.88 ± 3.07), and kidney (4.30 ± 2.89). Education and household income emerged as consistent predictors of health literacy across all cancers. Age, sex, employment status, and a family history of cancer were associated with colorectal cancer health literacy scores. Participants who reported higher levels of health literacy scores in esophageal cancer were older and had a previous cancer diagnosis. Participants who reported higher lung cancer health literacy scores were older, female, retired, and had a family history of cancer. Factors contributing to higher kidney cancer health literacy scores included education, annual household income, and non-smoking status.
CONCLUSION: Urban residents demonstrated moderate levels of cancer-related health literacy, and public health strategies should be targeted toward people with lower education and reduced annual household income. Implication for Practice: This research highlights the need for targeted educational interventions in community healthcare settings to identify urban residents at high risk of low health literacy, ultimately strengthening the reach and impact of cancer screening and prevention programs.
papers.title_zh: 中國城市居民對四大癌症的健康識能：一項全國性橫斷面調查
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：癌症是全球重大醫療挑戰，個人健康識能直接影響篩檢與自我照護行為的採納。目的：本研究旨在比較中國城市居民對四種癌症（大腸直腸癌、食道癌、肺癌、腎癌）的健康識能分數，並找出相關因子。方法：此描述性橫斷面研究透過專業人脈網絡在中國各地招募1,226名城市成年人。參與者提供人口學資料並完成經驗證的健康識能問卷。使用多元線性回歸分析與健康識能分數的關聯。結果：健康識能分數排序如下：大腸直腸癌（7.50 ± 3.35）、食道癌（6.27 ± 3.15）、肺癌（5.88 ± 3.07）、腎癌（4.30 ± 2.89）。教育程度與家庭收入是所有癌症中一致的健康識能預測因子。年齡、性別、就業狀態及癌症家族史與大腸直腸癌健康識能分數相關。食道癌健康識能分數較高者為年齡較長及先前有癌症診斷者。肺癌健康識能分數較高者為年齡較長、女性、退休及有癌症家族史者。腎癌健康識能分數較高的貢獻因子包括教育程度、年收入及不吸菸狀態。結論：城市居民展現中等程度的癌症相關健康識能，公共衛生策略應針對教育程度較低及年收入較低者。實務意涵：本研究強調在社區醫療場域中需要有針對性的教育介入，以識別健康識能低下的高風險城市居民，最終強化癌症篩檢與預防計畫的觸及率與影響力。
